data.description:
## Description

What: A pre-dispatch investigation spike that probes CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID across (a) initial session start, (b) after at least one auto-compact event (forced or natural), and (c) after a multi-day idle resume if reproducible, and records the observed values plus a stability verdict as a ticket comment on epic 53ef-d6fd-5ca5-4d62. Why: The entire epic mechanism (Session-Id trailer) is invalid if the env var is not stable across compaction; this is the CRITICAL Red Team scenario and must be resolved before implementation. If stability does NOT hold, implementation is BLOCKED and the design must be revised. Scope IN: env-var probing across the named scenarios; the (a) CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID runtime-contract checks (including that [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID" ] returns 0 at sprint Phase A start); recording observed values and verdict as an epic ticket comment. Scope OUT: any script implementation, hook, wrapper, or CI test (those depend on this spike passing).


## Done Definitions

- An epic ticket comment on 53ef-d6fd-5ca5-4d62 records the observed CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID value at session start, after at least one compaction event, and a stability verdict (stable / not-stable) ← Validates Closure Check: "CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID stability empirical verification (preplanning verification task before sprint dispatch): probe the env var value across (a) initial session start, (b) after one auto-compact event, (c) after a multi-day idle resume if reproducible. Record observed behavior in the epic ticket. If the variable is NOT stable across compaction (the critical Red Team scenario), this epic's primary mechanism is invalid — the verification task surfaces this before implementation work begins and the design is revised before sprint."
- [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID" ] returns exit 0 at sprint Phase A start, recorded in the runtime-contract portion of the epic ticket comment ← Validates Closure Check: "SC (Probe-6 remediation, architecture-vs-evidence audit 2026-05-16): In-session runtime + operator-action verification. Before the 53ef sprint can be marked complete, the two runtime/operator dependencies are verified in-session: (a) CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID runtime-contract checks and (b) operator-driven backfill dogfooding sub-bullets, captured as ticket comments on this epic."
- When the recorded stability verdict is not-stable, the spike's ticket comment explicitly states that sprint dispatch is BLOCKED pending design revision ← Validates Closure Check: "CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID stability empirical verification (preplanning verification task before sprint dispatch): probe the env var value across (a) initial session start, (b) after one auto-compact event, (c) after a multi-day idle resume if reproducible. Record observed behavior in the epic ticket. If the variable is NOT stable across compaction (the critical Red Team scenario), this epic's primary mechanism is invalid — the verification task surfaces this before implementation work begins and the design is revised before sprint."
- On a not-stable stability verdict, the spike emits a machine-checkable gate signal that the sprint orchestrator reads to BLOCK dispatch of draft-2..draft-8: it (a) applies the epic tag blocked:session-id-unstable to 53ef-d6fd-5ca5-4d62 AND (b) the verdict-gate verify command exits non-zero; on a stable verdict the tag is absent and the command exits zero. Ordering dependencies alone do not gate dispatch — the verdict VALUE gates it ← Validates Closure Check: "CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID stability empirical verification (preplanning verification task before sprint dispatch): probe the env var value across (a) initial session start, (b) after one auto-compact event, (c) after a multi-day idle resume if reproducible. Record observed behavior in the epic ticket. If the variable is NOT stable across compaction (the critical Red Team scenario), this epic's primary mechanism is invalid — the verification task surfaces this before implementation work begins and the design is revised before sprint."

## Considerations

- [Gating] This spike gates the entire epic: all implementation stories (draft-2..draft-8) depend on it. A not-stable verdict must halt implementation and trigger design revision rather than proceeding.
- [Artifact] The ticket comment is load-bearing (Probe-6 remediation) — it is the durable artifact verified at Phase I, not a transient note.
- [Reproducibility] The multi-day idle-resume scenario may not be reproducible in a single session; record it as best-effort and note non-reproducibility explicitly rather than omitting it.
- [Hard-gate] cc-4: a not-stable verdict must be a mechanical hard gate, not a soft ordering predecessor. The sprint orchestrator MUST check for the blocked:session-id-unstable tag (or the non-zero verdict-gate exit) before dispatching any of draft-2..draft-8 — a draft passing only its depends_on ordering is insufficient because a not-stable verdict still satisfies the ordering edge.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID stability empirically verified across compaction before any implementation begins, so that the session-ownership mechanism is proven valid (or the design is revised) before code is written.
